guide.celestialascent.abyss.armor.set: Full set: %s dashes you forward, you are immune to wither and darkness, get +2 hearts and +10%% speed, and the void can't kill you.
guide.celestialascent.abyss.armor.text: Build a %s and upgrade each Stellar piece with 8 Void Essence and 8 Stardust (the chestplate needs 12 essence).
guide.celestialascent.abyss.enter: Once you have defeated the Sun Herald, jump off any island in the Fallen Stars. Instead of dying, you fall into the Abyss.
guide.celestialascent.abyss.essence.text: %s glows in the stone, most of it deep down. A %s sometimes drops %s too.
guide.celestialascent.abyss.ground.text: %s cracks under your feet and falls away. The deeper you are, the faster it crumbles. Broken stone grows back after a minute. Keep moving!
guide.celestialascent.abyss.prepare: Bring Ender Pearls and Stardust. Together with Void Essence they make Ascension Pearls, which take you back to your spawn point from anywhere.
guide.celestialascent.abyss.sovereign.lo: Loot: the %s, 12 to 24 Void Essence and coins.
guide.celestialascent.abyss.sovereign.te: Craft an %s and use it below height 40 to call the %s. It has 3,000 health and four phases, calls wraiths and makes the ground collapse under you.
guide.celestialascent.ascendant.altar.te: In the %s, combine each Void piece with a Primordial Core, a Star Core and 16 Void Essence. The chestplate takes the %s instead of the essence.
guide.celestialascent.ascendant.intro: The final armor joins the power of every boss on the ladder.
guide.celestialascent.ascendant.list.alt: Plus, for the altar: 2 Star Cores, your Imperial Seal, 2 netherite blocks and 4 crying obsidian.
guide.celestialascent.ascendant.powers.k:
%s: Ender Blink
Sneak + %s: Void Dash
%s: night vision
guide.celestialascent.ascendant.powers.t:
Creative flight, +10 hearts, +6 attack damage, +25%% speed, +2 reach, faster mining.

Immune to fire, lava, falling, drowning, freezing, wither and the void.

Never hungry, constant Regeneration II, unbreakable.

All four titan elements at level II.
guide.celestialascent.ascendant.primordi: Craft a %s from one core of each element, a Colossus Core and Void Essence. One craft makes two, and you need four.
guide.celestialascent.constellations.int: The first time you defeat a boss, its constellation appears in your night sky (only you see your own) and you keep a bonus forever:
guide.celestialascent.constellations.lis:
%s: +1 armor
%s: breath lasts longer
%s: +3%% speed
%s: burning ends sooner
%s: +1 heart
%s: +1 armor toughness
%s: +0.5 reach
%s: +10%% swim speed
%s: +1 heart
%s: +5%% attack damage
guide.celestialascent.constellations.loo: Look up on a clear night to see them.
guide.celestialascent.dragon.before: Killed the dragon before you installed this mod? Respawn it once to get your first heart.
guide.celestialascent.dragon.count: You need at least 4 hearts: one for the Star Compass and one for each Ender Colossus you summon. Three Colossus fights give all the cores you need.
guide.celestialascent.dragon.head: A Dragon Head
guide.celestialascent.dragon.head.text: Also bring a %s from an End ship (Relic Dealers sell them too). It goes on the Star Gate's pedestal.
guide.celestialascent.dragon.heart: When the %s dies, every player within 200 blocks receives a %s. You need Dragon Hearts to find the Star Gate and to wake the Ender Colossus.
guide.celestialascent.dragon.more: Need more hearts? Place four End Crystals on the exit portal to respawn the dragon. Every fight gives another heart.
guide.celestialascent.economy.bank.text: A %s keeps coins in your account. Your balance works at every bank, survives death, and shops and pylons can take payment from it.
guide.celestialascent.economy.cities.tex: Rare walled towns in plains, savannas, deserts, taigas, meadows and snowy plains. Each has a bank, a market with stalls to rent and a relic pavilion with a Relic Dealer.
guide.celestialascent.economy.coins: Aster coins come in seven tiers. Each is worth ten of the tier below:
guide.celestialascent.economy.coins.earn: Your first coins come from a Banker villager (one emerald buys 5 Copper Asters), from boss loot and from Quest Boards.
guide.celestialascent.economy.coins.spli: Put any coin in the crafting grid to split it into ten of the tier below. To combine small coins, deposit them at a %s and withdraw bigger ones.
guide.celestialascent.economy.jobs.list:
Banker (%s): trades emeralds, gold and diamonds for coins, later netherite scrap and totems.

Titansmith (%s): maps to the Titan shrines and Elemental Sigils.

Relic Dealer (%s): Nether Stars, Elytra, Dragon Heads, Stardust and more.
guide.celestialascent.economy.jobs.pedes: Relic Pedestals can't be crafted. You find them in trade cities.
guide.celestialascent.economy.jobs.text: Place one of these next to a villager without a job:
guide.celestialascent.economy.quests.tex: A %s in a village offers three delivery quests each day. They pay coins and raise the village's prosperity. At each prosperity level the village builds something new by itself: stalls, cottages, a smithy, a watchtower.
guide.celestialascent.economy.shops.rent: Empty stalls in trade cities can be rented for 100 coins: sneak and right-click.
guide.celestialascent.economy.shops.text: Place a %s, fill its stock and set a price and bundle size. Buyers pay with coins or their bank balance, and the money goes straight into your account, even while you are offline.
guide.celestialascent.empire.armor.craft: Lost the forge from the pylon? You can craft another:
guide.celestialascent.empire.armor.set: Full set: %s makes you blink to where you look, endermen stay calm, and you get +1 reach.
guide.celestialascent.empire.armor.text: %s: upgrade each Titan piece here. The chestplate also needs a Colossus Core.
guide.celestialascent.empire.colossus.lo: Loot: %s, %s, Imperial Plating, Ender Gears and coins.
guide.celestialascent.empire.colossus.se: Keep your %s! It opens the Star Gate and you need it again for the Ascension Altar.
guide.celestialascent.empire.colossus.te: Use a %s on the empty throne in the throne hall to wake the %s (900 health).
guide.celestialascent.empire.intro: On the outer End islands (End highlands and midlands, past the gateway) lies the Ruined Capital, a broken city of purpur.
guide.celestialascent.empire.pylons.rewa:
Each pylon gives something else:

Pylon of Craft: drops an Imperial Forge.

Pylon of Trade: an Ender Merchant appears.

Pylon of the Throne: the barrier to the throne hall falls.
guide.celestialascent.empire.pylons.text: Three pylons (%s) stand in the city. You can't touch one while a Sentinel is within 24 blocks. Right-click a pylon while carrying 4 × %s, 16 Purpur Blocks and 3,000 coins (your bank balance counts).
guide.celestialascent.empire.sentinels.t: Every %s guarding the city has 300 health. Defeat them for %s and %s.
guide.celestialascent.evolution.complete:
Titan (%s): a core of the piece's own element and 3 Titan Shards; then 2 cores and 6 shards.

Imperial (%s): 3 Imperial Plating and 2 Ender Gears; then a Colossus Core, 3 Gears and 3 Plating.

Stellar (%s, at night): 12 Stardust; then a Star Core and 16 Stardust.

Void (%s): 8 Void Essence; then a Primordial Core and 12 Void Essence.

Ascendant (%s): a Star Core and 16 Void Essence; then a Primordial Core, a Star Core and a Dragon Heart.
Upgrading a piece into the next set starts its evolution over, so evolve the set you are going to keep.
Put the resonating piece into its set's station with the materials below (first for stage II, then for stage III):
guide.celestialascent.evolution.intro: Every piece of Celestial armor grows with you through three stages. Each stage adds armor and toughness, new parts appear on the armor, and a full set's ability gets stronger.
guide.celestialascent.evolution.resonanc: Fight while wearing it. Every monster you defeat adds resonance to each piece (a third of its health); a boss gives half of its health to everyone at the fight. Stage II needs 600 resonance, stage III 1,800.
The tooltip shows each piece's stage and resonance. When a piece is full, a message tells you.
guide.celestialascent.evolution.sets.tex:
A full set counts as the lowest stage among its four pieces:

Titan: II every element one level higher, III permanent Resistance.

Imperial: II blink 16 blocks, III 20 blocks with a shockwave.

Stellar: II Regeneration II at night, III falling stars strike attackers.

Void: II dash every 3 s, III every 2 s, tearing through monsters.

Ascendant: II farther blink and faster dash, III allies near you regenerate.
guide.celestialascent.intro.bosses.stars: The first time you defeat a boss, its constellation appears in your night sky and you get a small permanent bonus.
guide.celestialascent.intro.bosses.team: Playing together? A boss gets 50%% more health for each extra player nearby. Everyone who dealt at least 5%% of its health in damage gets their own loot.
guide.celestialascent.intro.bosses.text: One hit can take at most 8%% of a boss's health, so it takes many hits. Bosses can't be lured more than 48 blocks from their altar, and they teleport to you if you hide on a pillar.
guide.celestialascent.intro.keys.text: %s uses your armor's ability. %s switches its effect on or off (for example night vision). You can change both under Options, Controls.
guide.celestialascent.intro.ladder.list:
1. Elemental Titans: Titan armor
2. Ender Dragon: Dragon Heart
3. Lost Ender Empire: Imperial armor
4. Fallen Stars: Stellar armor
5. The Abyss: Void armor
6. Ascension: Ascendant armor
guide.celestialascent.intro.ladder.tip: The first page of this book always shows your next step. Click it to jump to the right chapter.
guide.celestialascent.intro.lost: Lost this book? Craft a new one from a book and an amethyst shard.
guide.celestialascent.intro.prepare.text: Get full netherite armor with good enchantments first. Titan armor is forged from netherite pieces, and it keeps their enchantments, so they are not wasted.
guide.celestialascent.intro.stages.text: Every boss evolves twice: at two thirds and at one third of its health new parts grow out of it, it changes colour and learns new attacks. A banner announces each stage, and the boss bar keeps showing it.
guide.celestialascent.intro.stages.ultim: In its third stage every boss has an ultimate attack of its own. When it starts, your action bar tells you how to survive it.
guide.celestialascent.intro.welcome: Celestial Ascent is a ladder of bosses beyond netherite and the Ender Dragon. Each boss drops what you need to reach the next one, and every step gives you a stronger armor set.
guide.celestialascent.next.ascend.desc: Combine your Void armor with Primordial Cores and Star Cores at the Ascension Altar.
guide.celestialascent.next.celestials.de: Find the gate with a Star Compass, open it and defeat the Astral Seraph and the Nebula Leviathan.
guide.celestialascent.next.done.desc: Every constellation shines for you. Fight the bosses again with friends or build a trading empire.
guide.celestialascent.next.dragon.desc: Every player nearby gets a Dragon Heart. Killed it before? Respawn it with End Crystals.
guide.celestialascent.next.empire.desc: Find the Ruined Capital in the outer End, restore its pylons and offer a Dragon Heart at the throne.
guide.celestialascent.next.herald.desc: Offer 16 Stardust at the third altar in the Fallen Stars.
guide.celestialascent.next.sovereign.des: Jump off the Fallen Stars, mine Void Essence and call the Void Sovereign with an Abyssal Beacon.
guide.celestialascent.next.titans.desc: Craft an Elemental Sigil and use it on the altar of the matching shrine.
guide.celestialascent.projecte.emc: Every Celestial Ascent item has an EMC value, so you can learn it in a Transmutation Table. The values are high: a Titan Shard is worth 250,000 EMC, an Ascendant Chestplate 1.6 billion.
guide.celestialascent.projecte.intro: ProjectE is optional. If it is installed:
guide.celestialascent.projecte.repair: Damaged Celestial armor repairs itself once a second using EMC from your transmutation knowledge. Server owners can turn this off in the config (emcRepair).
guide.celestialascent.projecte.without: Without ProjectE none of this applies. Everything else works the same.
guide.celestialascent.stargate.compass.t: Craft a %s and use it in the End. It tells you the direction and distance to the nearest gate.
guide.celestialascent.stargate.intro: Somewhere on the outer End islands stands a Star Gate: a dark ring with a pedestal in front of it.
guide.celestialascent.stargate.open.back: You arrive in the Fallen Stars next to a small return portal. Walk into it to go back to where you left.
guide.celestialascent.stargate.open.step:
1. Use a %s on the %s.

2. Use your %s on the pedestal. It is not used up.

3. The portal opens: step in.
guide.celestialascent.stars.armor.altar: Build a %s in the Overworld. It only works at night under open sky. A Dormant Star Core placed inside charges into a %s.
guide.celestialascent.stars.armor.cores: You need 10 Star Cores in total: 4 for Stellar armor, 4 for Ascendant armor and 2 for the Ascension Altar.
guide.celestialascent.stars.armor.set: Full set: you glide down gently instead of falling (sneak to drop faster), regenerate under the night sky and have night vision (switch it with %s).
guide.celestialascent.stars.armor.upgrad: Then upgrade each Imperial piece with a Star Core and 16 Stardust (the chestplate needs 24).
guide.celestialascent.stars.celestials.l: Loot: a %s, 8 to 16 Stardust and coins. Each altar can be used again after 10 minutes.
guide.celestialascent.stars.celestials.t:
Three sanctums float among the islands, each with an altar. Use 16 Stardust on an altar to summon its Celestial:

%s: 1,200 health
%s: 1,400 health
%s: 1,600 health, only after the other two.
guide.celestialascent.stars.danger: Don't fall! Until you have defeated the %s, the void below kills you.
guide.celestialascent.stars.intro: A dimension of floating starstone islands above an endless void, under a sky full of nebulae.
guide.celestialascent.stars.stardust.tex: Mine %s on the islands to get %s. You need 16 to summon each Celestial.
guide.celestialascent.titans.armor.eleme:
Frost: no freezing, frost walking; attackers are slowed (II: frozen).

Tide: water breathing, fast swimming (II: dolphin's grace, night vision underwater).

Storm: speed (II: lightning strikes your attackers).

Magma: fire immunity (II: walk on lava, attackers burn).
guide.celestialascent.titans.armor.forge: Build a %s. Put a netherite armor piece in it together with one titan core and four shards (%s). The piece keeps its enchantments and name and takes on the core's element.
guide.celestialascent.titans.armor.level: Wearing all four pieces, an element on one piece gives level I, on two or more pieces level II.
guide.celestialascent.titans.armor.reinf: Want a different element? Put a Titan piece back in the forge with another core and 2 shards.
guide.celestialascent.titans.armor.save: Keep spare cores: the Ascendant armor later needs two cores of every element.
guide.celestialascent.titans.fight.loot: Loot: its core, %s (3 to 5) and coins.
guide.celestialascent.titans.fight.text: %s 400, %s 450, %s 500 and %s 600 health. At two thirds and at one third of its health each titan evolves and unlocks new attacks, ending with an ultimate.
guide.celestialascent.titans.find.biomes:
Frost: snowy plains, groves, snowy slopes, ice spikes, frozen peaks.

Tide: oceans and deep oceans.

Storm: mountain peaks, windswept hills, meadows.

Magma: in the Nether, in basalt deltas and nether wastes.
guide.celestialascent.titans.find.existi: Installed the mod in a world you already played? Shrines are also built into land you explored before, at the same spots as in a new world. Where you built something, they move to a free spot nearby instead.
guide.celestialascent.titans.find.maps: The easy way: a Titansmith sells a map to the nearest shrine for 2 %s and a compass. Frost and Storm maps from level 3 (Journeyman), Tide and Magma maps from level 4 (Expert).
guide.celestialascent.titans.find.rare: Shrines are rare: at most one in every 400 by 400 blocks, and only where the biome fits.
guide.celestialascent.titans.intro: Four titans sleep in shrines across the world. Each one guards an element and drops its core when defeated.
guide.celestialascent.titans.summon.cool: Each altar rests for 10 minutes after a summon. A Titansmith at level 5 (Master) also sells sigils.
guide.celestialascent.titans.summon.text: Craft the matching Elemental Sigil and use it on the altar in the middle of the shrine. After a short ritual the titan awakens.
guide.celestialascent.ui.title: Celestial Codex
message.celestialascent.abyss_enter: You fall through the bottom of the stars... into the Abyss.
message.celestialascent.abyss_rejects: The void below rejects you. Defeat the Sun Herald first.
message.celestialascent.beacon_deeper: The beacon only answers deep in the Abyss (below y=40)
message.celestialascent.codex_given: You received the Celestial Codex. Right-click it to see what to do next.
message.celestialascent.colossus_awakens: The Ender Colossus rises from the Empty Throne!
message.celestialascent.compass_nothing: No Star Gate answers the compass
message.celestialascent.compass_points: A Star Gate lies %s, %s blocks away
message.celestialascent.compass_spins: The needle spins wildly. It only works in the End.
message.celestialascent.constellation: A new constellation appears in your night sky: %s
message.celestialascent.dragon_heart: The dragon's heart still beats. The Lost Ender Empire stirs on the outer islands...
message.celestialascent.gate_head: The dragon head settles on the pedestal. Now present the Imperial Seal.
message.celestialascent.gate_needs_head: The pedestal awaits a Dragon Head
message.celestialascent.gate_needs_seal: Present the Imperial Seal to open the gate
message.celestialascent.gate_open: The Star Gate opens onto the Fallen Stars!
message.celestialascent.herald_eclipse: The Sun Herald darkens the sky: ECLIPSE!
message.celestialascent.herald_supernova: The Sun Herald burns white-hot. Find cover before the SUPERNOVA!
message.celestialascent.hint.crystal_cho: Break the crystals before they heal it!
message.celestialascent.hint.tempest: Find a gap in the lightning ring!
message.celestialascent.pylon_guarded: A Sentinel Construct guards this pylon
message.celestialascent.pylon_needs: To restore this pylon bring %s Imperial Plating, %s Purpur Blocks and %s
message.celestialascent.pylon_restore.cr: The Pylon of Craft blazes to life! The Imperial Forge is yours.
message.celestialascent.pylon_restore.th: The Pylon of the Throne roars. The Throne Hall's barrier falls!
message.celestialascent.pylon_restore.tr: The Pylon of Trade glows. An Ender Merchant steps out of the void.
message.celestialascent.resonance_full: %s is resonating! Complete its evolution at: %s
message.celestialascent.shop_cannot_affo: You can't afford this (coins or bank balance)
message.celestialascent.shop_out_of_stoc: This shop is out of stock
message.celestialascent.shop_own_shop: You can't buy from your own shop
message.celestialascent.sovereign_phase_: The Sovereign calls the wraiths of the deep!
message.celestialascent.stall_rented: You rented this stall. Right-click to stock it.
message.celestialascent.stall_unclaimed: Unclaimed stall. Sneak + right-click to rent it for %s
message.celestialascent.throne_hint: The throne hungers for a Dragon Heart
message.celestialascent.village_grew: The village has grown: a new %s was built!
message.celestialascent.wrong_sigil: This altar answers to a different element
